front.note: Front setback must match the alignment of primary facades on adjoining properties; where they differ, use their average.

side.note: Table E-1.2: 1st storey (up to 4m) 900mm; 2nd storey (up to 7m) 1.5m; 3rd storey or higher (greater than 7m) 2.5m.

rear.note: Rear setbacks to match adjoining properties; if not characteristic use Part F Planning Area character statement.

garage.note: No street-setback value; garages/carports not between street frontage and primary facade (2013 DCP s1.5.4 P10); laneway 1.2m.
